race.comment: NAVY ROSE (11) has the right profile to take sharp improvement from her Gosford debut, beaten two and a half lengths after settling midfield and looming into the race. Opts to run here rather than later in the card and the debut sets her up nicely back to country level. The one to beat. PONZI SCHEME (6) comes back from provincial company after finishing fifth to Alpha Sort at Illawarra Grange, and his Nowra third the start prior gives him a solid enough platform if the return to 1000m proves suitable. SWORN (12) is the unknown with upside, debuting for a strong local stable with Craig Newitt booked and with the blinkers on. She would've been set for this and a strong showing is on the cards. STILL THE MOON (7) was beaten a nose at this track first-up and has the recent race fitness to be highly competitive again. HAZEL BAY (2) has shown enough in strong trials to suggest he can run a cheeky race on debut.
